successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Kénédougou, taken by the French at Sikasso on 1 May 1898

ledger.x: c. 1650: the Traoré found Kénédougou round Bougoula. Infobox "Established: c. 1650"; "first established in the 17th century by the Dioula Traore clan".
1877: Tieba moves the capital from Bougoula to Sikasso.
under Tieba (1877-1893): the Minianka region is conquered.
1888: the siege is lifted after 15 months and a French column relieves the city; Tieba then allies with the French (undated).

wars.name: Siege of Sikasso
wars.outcome: Samori besieged Sikasso for 15 months from April 1887 with 12,000 men and failed; a French column relieved the city and Tieba signed a treaty of alliance with the French.

wars.name: Samori-Kénédougou conflict
wars.outcome: The conflict "began in 1884" on the Bagoe River frontier; no border change before the siege.

wars.name: French conquest of Kénédougou
wars.outcome: The French artillery assault of 15 April 1898 took Sikasso on 1 May 1898; Babemba had himself killed.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier; the state is a core round Bougoula/Sikasso with the Minianka added later.
